name: Methoxamine
aliases: 2,5-dimethoxynorephedrine, Méthoxamédrine, Methoxamin, Méthoxamine, Methoxaminum, Metossamina, Metoxamina, Pseudomethoxamine
summary: Methoxamine, sold under the brand names Vasoxine, Vasoxyl, and Vasylox among others, is a sympathomimetic medication used as an antihypotensive agent. It has mostly or entirely been discontinued. The drug is an α1-adrenergic receptor agonist.

pharmacology.text: Methoxamine is an α1-adrenergic receptor agonist. It is described as a long-acting α1-adrenergic receptor agonist and this is contrasted with phenylephrine which is said to be short-acting. Phenylephrine is 5 to 10 times more potent than methoxamine and has a 3-fold higher maximal effect.

uses.text: Methoxamine, sold under the brand names Vasoxine, Vasoxyl, and Vasylox among others, is a sympathomimetic medication used as an antihypotensive agent. It has mostly or entirely been discontinued.

sideEffects.en: It can cause high blood pressure, headache and a slow heart rate as the body responds to the rise in pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能引起高血壓、頭痛，以及身體因應血壓升高而出現的心跳變慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能引起高血压、头痛，以及身体因应血压升高而出现的心跳变慢。

fact.en: Methoxamine is 2,5-dimethoxynorephedrine, so it shares the ring pattern of psychedelics such as DOM, yet it acts mainly on blood vessels.
fact.zh: 甲氧明即2,5-二甲氧基去甲麻黃鹼，與 DOM 等迷幻藥共用相同的環上取代模式，但它主要作用於血管。
fact.zhHans: 甲氧明即2,5-二甲氧基去甲麻黄碱，与 DOM 等迷幻药共用相同的环上取代模式，但它主要作用于血管。
